name: Amplitude Studios
description: Founded in 2011, Amplitude Studios is famous for its strategy and 4X games. It's a community centric game studio, that created a community platform called "Games2Gether". The studio is well knowned for it's 4X games: Endless Space, Endless Legend or Humankind.

games.title: Endless Dungeon
games.description: Plunge into an abandoned space station alone or with friends in co-op, recruit a team of shipwrecked heroes, and protect your crystal against never-ending waves of monsters... or die trying, get reloaded, and try again.

name: Playrion
description: Founded in 2010, Playrion is a web/mobile game studio focused on strategy and management games. It's best known for Airlines Manager and Airport Simulator: First Class. In 2020, Player became part of the Paradox studios ecosystem.

games.title: Airlines Manager
games.description: Airlines Manager is a free aviation management game. In the game, you manage your airline like a real tycoon and strategize to become the greatest CEO in the aviation world!

games.title: Harry le jeu de mot
games.description: Mobile adaptation of a french tv program. The goal is to find words based on letters rotating around themselves in rings.

games.title: Plane Panic
games.description: Take control of a plane during takeoff and make it fly as far as possible despite losing an engine on the nearest runway!

games.title: SpeedQuizz
games.description: SpeedQuizz is a mobile quiz game where players can test their knowledge. You progress through multiple environments, in a car and can compare your progression with your friends.
